coordinate_basis: Unscaled 512 x 512 source image; pixel origin is top left. CSS percentage = pixel / 512 * 100. Preserve the image aspect ratio and apply overlays relative to its exact displayed image box.

grid.status: Visually verified from the printed grid on both downloaded images
grid.formula: For one-based column c and row r: left = 16 + 32*(c-1), top = 16 + 32*(r-1), width = height = 32.
grid.warning: Do not copy the wiki tooltip's left/top values directly onto the raw image: they are not the visually measured raw-image grid bounds.

world_to_pixel_transform.note: No independently verified world-to-map affine transform was located. Do not present the approximate landmark markers below as computed positions from x/y/z. The package coordinate triples are confirmed source data, but the map-square association for a custom Scout remains an inference unless separately verified in the client.

landmarks.marker_status: Visually estimated endpoint of the printed Outpost pointer; not an exact custom NPC position.

landmarks.label: La Theine entrance area — approximate
landmarks.grid_square: K/L-6 area, not a confirmed exact Scout square
landmarks.grid_status: Inference for older Scout variants. The original map visibly shows the northern corridor at the K/L boundary around row 6; the wiki confirms the actual La Theine Plateau zone connection farther north at L-5. A Campsitarus FoV guide lists the nearby Field Manual at K-6, not L-6. Prefer a two-cell shaded area rather than an exact Scout pin.
landmarks.field_manual_reference_note: The guide explicitly lists Valkurm Field Manual locations H-7, K-6, L-11. This supports caution about asserting L-6 but does not itself confirm which world coordinate belongs to that native manual or a custom Scout.
landmarks.marker_status: Visual approximation of the northern corridor only. Recommended UI is the two-cell shaded K/L-6 area, not this point. No verified affine transform supports an exact custom Scout pin.
